_help: One entry per rider. update.py builds data/races.json from every rider here. id: stable rider id (the Turritt ID when the rider has one). name: as written on Turritt/EQ Timing. turritt_id / eq_id: result profiles (leave out if none). intervals_key_env: the env var (GitHub Actions secret) holding this rider's intervals.icu API key; without it the rider gets placings but no new watts. intervals_via_proxy: only for the dev container, whose proxy injects Pedår's key. publish_power: false leaves watts out of races.json. sheet: optional hand-kept CSV to start from. since: first season to fetch (older race lists cost a request each). exclude: regex of race names to leave out. eq_points_events: EQ Timing points races (kermesse) the rider rode without scoring; those aren't in their EQ history, so they are listed here (scored ones are found by themselves). ssk_cup: the rider's name in the raceresult list, and rounds ridden in Sort klasse.
